mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS plant_id, p.name AS name, p.type::text AS type, ST_X(p.location) AS lng, ST_Y(p.location) AS lat, sub_warning.max_warning_level AS warning_level, sub_weather.latest_temp AS latest_temp FROM t_power_plant p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( -- 子查询：取该电厂所在行政区划当前生效的最高预警等级 SELECT CASE w.level::text WHEN 'red' THEN 4 WHEN 'orange' THEN 3 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 2 WHEN 'blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS level_rank, w.level::text AS max_warning_level FROM t_weather_warning w WHERE w.district_code = p.district_code AND w.status = 'active' AND (w.expire_time IS NULL OR w.expire_time > now()) ORDER BY level_rank DESC LIMIT 1 ) sub_warning ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( -- 子查询：取该电厂最新温度（通过行政区划关联气象实况） SELECT (w.content_json->>'temperature')::double precision AS latest_temp FROM t_weather_warning w WHERE w.district_code = p.district_code AND w.status = 'active' AND w.type::text = 'high_temp' AND (w.expire_time IS NULL OR w.expire_time > now()) ORDER BY w.publish_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) sub_weather ON true WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.location IS NOT NULL AND ST_Within( p.location, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{minLng}, #{minLat}, #{maxLng}, #{maxLat}, 4326) ) ORDER BY p.id ASC
